title: Khudam suffix mapping
description: One Cyrillic suffix mapped to one traditional written-apart suffix variant. The same cyrillic value may appear in several rows — one per traditional variant. Conditions (attach, gender) are evaluated against the TRADITIONAL stem the suffix would join, never the Cyrillic surface. Rules and citations live in data/GRAMMAR.md.

cyrillic.description: The suffix as it appears at the end of the modern Cyrillic word: lowercase а-я plus ё, ө, ү, NFC-normalized.

traditional.description: The traditional suffix in standard Unicode (U+1800–U+18AF), logical code points only, WITHOUT the NNBSP — the converter inserts U+202F when joining stem and suffix.

latin.description: Optional romanization of the traditional suffix.

sense.description: Grammatical label shown to users to tell candidates apart, e.g. "genitive", "plural".

attach.description: Optional condition: what the traditional stem must end in for this variant to apply.

gender.description: Optional condition: the vowel-harmony class the traditional stem must have. Stems with neither class (only ᠢ) match both variants.

verified.description: true only after a human reviewer confirmed the spelling via pull request. Machine-transcribed rows are always false.

citation.description: Reference for the rule variant, e.g. "Nadmid 1990 p. 15" — see data/GRAMMAR.md § Sources.
